rel.panel.intro: Track affection per character. Values are saved with each playthrough.
rel.showMeter: Show the heart meter when affection changes
rel.threshold.hint: Used by Affection Branch nodes without their own threshold.
rel.panel.usage: Use the “Change affection” block, the Affection Branch node, the “Affection on enter” scene module, or affection("Name") in conditions.
rel.node.branch.desc: Continues through High or Low depending on a character's affection.
rel.prop.threshold.desc: Leave empty to use the character's threshold from the Relationships panel.
rel.comp.onEnter.desc: Changes a character's affection when this scene starts.
